programmes.d: As each lead turns cold in a gruesome murder case, Dr. G worries justice may never be served. As the autopsy draws to an end, Dr. G uncovers a shocking clue that may solve this crime.
A daughter wants to surprise her dad with breakfast in bed but finds him unresponsive. His family is convinced they know what killed him, but Dr. G must let the evidence speak for itself.
A teacher excuses himself for a nap after dinner, but he never wakes up. The man has a complex medical history that leads Dr. G on a hunt for an explanation for his mysterious death.
A woman fears the worst when her aunt stops answering her calls. When her greatest fear is confirmed, Dr. G must determine one thing: was this a fatal fall?
The promise of love is within reach as the farmers head out on their final solo dates.
Each farmer and his family welcomes one of his two ladies' families to the farm.
The visits continue as each farmer and his family meet the second of his two ladies' families.
Each of the four farmers reveals which of his ladies has captured his heart.

programmes.d: In this TV special, a man comes into the ER with a surprising body part stuck inside a camping stove.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Worst Day Ever
programmes.d: In this TV special, two skydivers land on a metal post and a woman is rushed into the ER with a tie rod sticking out of her temple. Then, a woman arrives with a stiletto heel stuck in her ear.

A boy suffers from a massive brain hemorrhage after being hit by a baseball bat. He is rushed to surgery, where it's discovered that he also has kidney failure.
Kassie arrives and is diagnosed with pneumonia. Dr Tellez devises a treatment that has never been attempted before. Will he win the gamble?
The force of a tornado drove a fence picket through Julie's neck. With it blocking her airways, the only way of saving her is to pull it out.
Seven-year-old Brian has been hit by a truck and his arm has been ripped off. In a ten-hour operation, Dr Gottlieb attempts to re-attach the arm.
Jarret is rushed into ER after being violently tackled in a football game. A CAT scan reveals that his liver is split and he needs emergency surgery.
A skier clings to life after slamming into a tree at 50mph. By the time he reaches the hospital he's a talking corpse.
A six-year-old Chinese girl is rushed in with intermittent seizures, but with a language barrier, will the doctor find out what's wrong with her?
More than 1,000lbs of dry wall crush onto a young boy's chest, stopping blood circulation to his vital organs. Doctors fear the worst.
Gripping tales of medical emergencies. Doctors must look after their own when a psychotic gunman enters the hospital and starts shooting staff. Dr May is shot in the head, but can his colleague save.
A mother and son are brought in after a horrific car accident. The son was not wearing a seat belt during the crash and was ejected from the car.
A woman is killed in a drunk driving accident. At first, her death seems to be an open-and-shut case, but Dr. G discovers clues that the woman may have played a key role in her own death.
A mother of infant twins notices that her son is not breathing. EMTs attempt to revive him, but it's too late. Now, Dr. G must work fast to determine if the other twin's life is in danger.
A florist meets with clients for an upcoming wedding, but she suddenly collapses to the floor. With no apparent cause of death, Dr. G worries that this case may go unsolved.
When an infant dies under mysterious circumstances, the young parents are prime suspects. Dr. G discovers several clues that bolster the child abuse theory, but the case is not clear-cut.
